statements.notes: Quarterly figure (Q2 2022), not full-year. Data Center segment revenue is driven mainly by EPYC server CPUs rather than AI accelerators, but the rubric treats data-center revenue as in scope. The segment table in p09 gives the exact figure as $1,486 million.

statements.quote: For the third quarter of 2022, AMD expects revenue to be approximately $6.7 billion, plus or minus $200 million, an increase of approximately 55% year-over- year led by growth in the Data Center and Embedded segments.

statements.quote: For the full year 2022, AMD continues to expect revenue to be approximately $26.3 billion, plus or minus $300 million, an increase of approximately 60% over 2021 led by growth in the Data Center and Embedded segments.
statements.notes: Full-year 2022 total revenue guidance with Data Center cited as a driver. This is not AI revenue. The range is the stated $26.3B plus or minus $300M.
